panels.description: Decoded sample counts by exact packet format and size.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT packet_format,packet_size,COUNT(*) AS samples FROM samples GROUP BY packet_format,packet_size ORDER BY packet_size

panels.title: Packet formats

panels.description: Decoder schema, supported exact sizes, byte-coverage assertion, and rejected-packet diagnostics.
panels.title: Decoder status

panels.description: Background reconciliation state. Errors do not block primary telemetry writes.
panels.title: Mirror status

panels.description: Per-lap source and availability. Missing historical native fields remain explicitly unavailable.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT source,available,COUNT(*) AS channels FROM lap_channel_provenance GROUP BY source,available ORDER BY source

panels.title: Channel provenance

panels.description: Native unknown values are evidence only. Their names encode byte offsets; no physical meaning is implied.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT t AS time, ${unknown_channel:raw} AS value FROM samples WHERE lap_id=${lap:raw} AND ${unknown_channel:raw} IS NOT NULL ORDER BY sample_index

panels.title: $unknown_channel (raw/unknown)

panels.description: Independent checks of native evidence versus compatibility transforms.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT t AS time,native_speed_mps*3.6 AS native_speed_kmh,speed AS derived_speed_kmh,native_throttle_raw*100.0/255.0 AS native_throttle_pct,throttle AS derived_throttle_pct FROM samples WHERE lap_id=${lap:raw} ORDER BY sample_index

panels.title: Native versus normalized

list.name: lap
list.label: Lap
list.query: SELECT id AS __value, 'Session ' || session_id || ' / Lap ' || number AS __text FROM laps ORDER BY id DESC

list.name: unknown_channel
list.label: Unknown field
list.query: SELECT name AS __value, name || ' [' || unit || '; ' || confidence || ']' AS __text FROM channel_catalog WHERE classification IN ('unknown','padding') ORDER BY source_offset
